hook.line: Title card: tutorial for the SEO job bot (Russian).
hook.visual: Static green wave title card, big white 'SEO' over 'БОТ' and small 'тутор на бота seojob', letterboxed in black; no motion for 3 s.

beats.what: Title card announcing a tutorial for an SEO task bot
Screen recording of Yandex Maps search: open the Joker Auto business card
Visits the business website from the card
Opens route directions to the business
On-screen note in brackets tells the viewer to take a screenshot at this moment
Red hand-drawn arrow points at the 4.9 rating on the business card
Scrolls the reviews tab (444 reviews) to finish the task

why_it_works: Shows the exact taps in the real app, so a viewer doing the paid task can follow step by step
A bracketed instruction and a red arrow mark the two moments that matter (screenshot, rating)
Frequent on-screen changes (measured 30 events per minute) keep the scroll moving despite no face
weaknesses: Opening 3 s is a static title card with nothing moving
Niche audience: instructions for a specific task bot, no promise of a result
Long blurred stretch near the end where nothing is readable
for_robert: Avoid a static title card as the hook; borrow the hand-drawn red arrow to point at the one number that matters on a screen.
